title: Ray's Utilities
description: A port of my Ray's Dongles containing all the utilities. Charms, & various tools
body:
This mod is a smaller portion of my Ray's Dongles mod. This mod adds the utilities section to its own mod. Contains all the tools, and charms that Ray's Dongles had!

It has the hammers, excavators, paxels, & if you choose to use my Ray's Materials mod in conjuction with this mod, it will enable the Ruby & Topaz variants of tools as well.

~~Eventually I plan too split my main mod up into different categories of mods, to make porting easier in the future. This is the 1st of a few mini ports to come.~~

Ray's Materials is now available on Curseforge & Modrinth!
Ray's Agriculture is now available on Curseforge & Modrinth!
